newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Email sees further improved results.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Email sees further improved results.

text.p: Manufacturing group Email Ltd said on Thursday it expected to record further improved results in 1997/98, after posting a higher profit before abnormals of A$58.7 million for the year to March 31, 1997.
This compared with A$53.3 million in the previous year, the company said in a statement.
Email said demand during the last quarter to March 1997 was appreciably stronger for the metals group and major appliances.
"However, demand since balance date has been more in line with the subdued climate of the previous year," it added.
The effects of predicted upturns in both residential and commercial building had been slow to appear.
"The company is expecting further improved results in 1997/98, based on the internal cost, quality and performance initiatives in place," it said.
The degree of improvement would depend upon the prevailing economic conditions.
Email said profit before tax and goodwill amortisation rose 31.8 percent on the previous year to A$94.0 million.
Tax almost doubled to A$29.12 million, while goodwill amortisation more than doubled to A$6.2 million following the acquisition of Atlas Steels.
Net profit after abnormals rose to A$55.266 million, compared with A$55.14 million.
